notes.title: Developer Stream: Zoink! Games and Ripstone - 25/11/16
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Got questions to ask about Stick It To The Man? Interested in the art style or what inspired the game aesthetic? Want to learn more about what it's like to work in the Zoink! offices?

Join us on Friday for a live stream with developers Klaus and Emil from Zoink Games to talk about how we worked together to bring Stick It to the world! 

Leave your questions below and we will answer as many as we can on stream, which starts on Friday 25th November at 4pm GMT / 8am PST.

[url=twitch.tv/ripstonegames]Watch the stream![/url]

Hope to see some of you in the chat as we talk about the development process of Stick It <3

notes.title: Support Special Effect for One Special Day: 15th July 2016
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Tomorrow (Friday 15th July) we are taking part in the One Special Day charity drive to raise money for the gamers charity [url=onespecialday.org.uk] Special Effect [/url]. We will be donating the profits from every single game that we sell tomorrow to Special Effect to support the amazing work they do to make games accessible to everyone. This includes all our games on Steam and also our console and mobile games. 

If you would like to support Special Effect, this is a really easy way to do so whilst bagging a new game at the same time.

We are also hosting a 6 hour One Special Day Twitch stream tomorrow, from 11am - 5pm (UK time). Hollie, Mike and Michelle will be playing through the Ripstone catalogue throughout the day, with code giveaways, competitions, developer chats and much more. We would love to see some of you in the chat on Friday to show your support for Special Effect!

[url=twitch.tv/ripstonegames]One Special Day Twitch Stream 
[/url]

notes.title: Stick It to The Man! coming to PS4 too
notes.content: Indie adventure game Stick It to The Man! is continuing to expand to more platforms, this time with an announcement of an impending PlayStation 4 version. It will be hitting the new console on May 6, beating the Wii U release which is still scheduled for late spring.

notes.title: New Weeklong Deals, Monday February 24th
notes.content: New Weeklong Deals roll over every Monday at 10AM Pacific Time.

notes.title: Stick It To The Man coming to Wii U
notes.content: The adventure game Stick It To The Man is coming to yet another platform, Swedish developer Zoink! has announced. It hit PlayStation systems in November followed by PC in December, and now it's on its way to the next logical home for such a thing: Wii U.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Stick it to The Man!
notes.content:
Stick it to The Man! is Now Available on Steam and 40% off.

Meet Ray, he lives in a world where everything is made out of paper and stickers. One day he has an accident and wakes up with a giant pink spaghetti arm sticking out of his brain. This gives him awesome powers and he can suddenly change the world around him by folding it, tearing it, pulling stickers off and sticking them elsewhere! And if that weren't enough, Ray can also read peoples minds! Digging into the brains of his fellow citizens, Ray can hear their thoughts and use that to his advantage. Unfortunately, Ray doesn't have much time to get to grips with his new abilities. He is framed by ‘The Man’ with a crime he didn’t commit, and is on the run. Can you help to get Ray out of this sticky situation? Get ready to tear it, rip it and Stick it to the Man!

*Offer Ends December 20th at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Stick it to The Man! coming to PC
notes.content: Having torn apart a world of paper and stickers on PlayStation 3 and Vita using its brain-arm, Stick It to the Man! is making a move on PC. Zoink's weird adventure game is coming via Steam later this month, because gosh, shouldn't every adventure game be home in time for Christmas?
